subject: Co-sell preflight: Marketplace demo preflight checklist & fallback windows
messages:
From: Sam Perez <sam.perez@aureliahealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@aureliahealth.com>, Stephen Park <stephen.park@aws-partner.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + request: 3-way marketplace demo (Aurelia Health x Redwood x AWS SI)

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the great conversation last week. We'd like to lock in a co-sell demo where Redwood will present the inference flow for our patient triage use case, AWS SI (Stephen) will cover infra/topology, and Aurelia will walk through the integration points. Goal: a 45 minute live demo + 15 minute operational Q&A for our engineering and procurement teams.

Constraints:
- Prefer week of July 5th; two PST-friendly windows: mornings 9–11am PT or late afternoons 3–5pm PT.
- Security folks may want a short SOC2/dataflow slide before the demo.
- We need preflight network details and an ops runbook 72 hours before the demo.

Can you propose 2 time slots and confirm who from Redwood will be on the call? Also, is a dedicated staging model instance needed (we can provide a small VPC peering)?

Thanks,
Sam Perez
Product Lead, Aurelia Health
--
Sam Perez
Aurelia Health
sam.perez@aureliahealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sam Perez <sam.perez@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Stephen Park <stephen.park@aws-partner.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@aureliahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + request: 3-way marketplace demo (Aurelia Health x Redwood x AWS SI)

Hi Sam — great to hear and congrats on moving this forward.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue, Jul 6 — 10:00–11:00am PT (45m demo + 15m ops)
- Thu, Jul 8 — 3:30–4:30pm PT (45m demo + 15m ops)

Attendees from Redwood: me (lead demo), Vanessa Ortiz (Solutions — infra & billing questions), and Karthik Iyer (partner ops & runbook owner).

Short answers:
- We recommend a dedicated staging instance pinned to a small dedicated pool for consistency. If you can provide VPC peering, we’ll accept that — otherwise we can host a private demo model on Redwood Dedicated for the session.
- We’ll circulate a one-page runbook and the network requirements matrix by EOD Wed (72 hours before July 6 slot).

Attachments: redwood_cosell_runbook_v1.pdf (ops checklist), network_requirements_matrix.xlsx (ports & IPs), demo-ops-checklist.txt (short checklist).

Stephen — can you confirm whether AWS SI prefers the Jul 6 morning or Jul 8 afternoon slot and whether they need an on-prem firewall note added to the matrix?

Sam/Laura — which slot would you prefer?

Best,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Field Solutions, Redwood Inference
+1 (650) 555-0199

From: Stephen Park <stephen.park@aws-partner.com>

Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + request: 3-way marketplace demo (Aurelia Health x Redwood x AWS SI)

On Mon, Jun 21, 2027 at 10:03 AM Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com> wrote:
> Evelyn: proposed slots (PT) ...

Thanks — Jul 6 morning works best for the AWS SI engineering lead. We prefer Jul 6 10:00–11:00am PT.

Operational ask from the SI side: please ensure the network matrix lists the CIDR ranges for the demo VPC and the exact ephemeral port range for model serving (we saw timeouts in a previous run when ephemeral ports were blocked). I can add firewall notes after I see the matrix.

Also: Stephen Park (AWS SI) will join with an infra lead (Priya Shah) and a Solutions Architect (Marco Ruiz). Priya will need the runbook and an Ops Slack channel ahead of the demo for live troubleshooting.

See you on Jul 6 10:00am PT.

-Stephen
Stephen Park
Partner Solutions, AWS SI
stephen.park@aws-partner.com

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + request: 3-way marketplace demo (Aurelia Health x Redwood x AWS SI)

Confirmed for Tue, Jul 6 — 10:00–11:00am PT. Final checklist and runbook are attached and linked below. Quick notes and fallbacks: 

- Final agenda (45m demo / 15m Q&A): 1) 10m: Aurelia product context & goals; 2) 20m: Redwood live inference walkthrough; 3) 15m: infra & integration patterns (Stephen/Priya/Marco); 4) 15m: operational Q&A.
- Preflight items for Aurelia (due Fri, Jul 2): completed network matrix, a test API key (scoped to demo traffic), and list of internal reviewers for procurement.
- Fallbacks if Jul 6 has infra trouble: 1) switch to pre-recorded demo + live Q&A (we will host recording on a private S3 link), 2) move to Jul 8 3:30pm PT as backup.
- Live troubleshooting channel: #ops-aurelia-demo (we'll create and invite guests by Mon, Jul 5).

Attachments (final): redwood_cosell_runbook_v1.pdf; network_requirements_matrix.xlsx; demo-ops-checklist.txt
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890
DocuSign preview: DocuSign: 0a1b2c3d-preview

Vanessa/Karthik — please confirm you will join the prep call on Mon, Jul 5 11:00am PT to do a technical dry run. Sam/Laura — I will follow up with calendar invites and the Slack channel invite.

Thanks all,
Evelyn
Head of Field Solutions | Redwood Inference
